name: US Treasury Fiscal Data API
notes: 80 endpoints covering US federal financial data. Completely free, no API key or registration required. RESTful GET requests only. Supports query parameters: fields, filter, sort, format, pagination. Datasets include: Daily Treasury Statement, Debt to the Penny, Monthly Treasury Statement, currency exchange rates. AI-friendly: clean REST design, supports CSV/JSON/XML output, filterable and sortable. Example: https://api.fiscaldata.treasury.gov/services/api/fiscal_service/v1/accounting/od/debt_to_penny
